requirements.definition: | GC-06 | Update assistant context to the current page and business. Keep the conversation coherent as the owner navigates. | int10 shows booking/calendar/overview suggestion chips while Products is open. Provide contextually useful actions rather than repeating the same generic chips after each answer. |
requirements.blocker: Remaining implementation or full-clause/live verification is outstanding; this is not an external blocker.
changes: Saved owner-controlled business avatar and 3–5 page-specific actions; permission-filtered UI; conversation/memory references clear when authorized business or role access changes. My Page mobile Info/Services/Location/More exposes actual editors. Conversation options keep voice, setup and opt-in memory accessible without permanent tall panels.

Own-business seven-day capacity evidence now unions canonical booked/held/blocked intervals, excludes unavailable/draft resources, ranks up to six dated professional opportunities, and opens that exact Calendar scope for review. It is not a historical demand, service-fit, profit or market-price claim. The assistant receives a complete bounded projection rather than depth-truncated interval objects.

Assistant marketplace rescheduling now prepares a scoped reviewed proposal, preserves booked terms, requires explicit owner confirmation, persists Pending state with exact readback and waits for customer acceptance. It does not immediately move the appointment. Manual-booking rescheduling remains separate; durable notification failure is reported truthfully.

The existing authorized business-summary read now exposes historical completed-appointment patterns by local weekday and six-hour period. It excludes partial/future days, compares only nonzero observed periods over sufficient local calendar days, and explicitly does not infer opening hours, demand, zero-capacity periods or forecasts. No new data query or identity projection is introduced.

Bookings and the assistant expose same-business regular-client absence evidence using explicit canonical identities, at least three completed visits from 365 local calendar days before today through the current check time (including today), last visit at least 42 local calendar days ago and no active current/future appointment. No other business history, name/email matching, inferred demand or contact permission is used. Assigned staff receive only their authorized professional scope.

Finances allows an owner to allocate existing canonical operating expense/wage evidence to a completed service period. A fresh reviewed contribution, compared with fewer completed appointments in an equal prior local-day period, supports service/calendar review. It is not verified net profit, capacity or demand. The same bounded safe facts reach business and earnings assistant summaries, with fresh earnings/bookings/styles grants, exact period binding and no review notes/client/source identities.
verification: SCHEDULE-OPPORTUNITIES-ACCEPTANCE.md: focused core/authorization/count/DST/projection regressions and14 Chromium/WebKit cases now pass on the combined production build. The previous $59/$69/$89 pricing should not be treated as the final direction. The product is now intended to be a premium operating system with AI, finance, communications, localization, marketing, website, booking and other infrastructure.

Starter | $89/month | Premium core operating system for independent professionals and smaller businesses.
